entries.title: Genesis 28:1

entries.title: Genesis 28:2
segments: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

entries.title: Genesis 28:3

entries.title: Genesis 28:4

entries.title: Genesis 28:5
segments: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

entries.title: Genesis 28:6
segments: ¶When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

words.text: from thence; and that as he blessed
him he gave him a charge

entries.title: Genesis 28:7
segments: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;

entries.title: Genesis 28:8
segments: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father; {pleased...: Heb. were evil in the eyes, etc}

words.text: ; {pleased...: Heb. were evil in the eyes, etc}

entries.title: Genesis 28:9
segments: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife. {Mahalath: or, Bashemath}

entries.title: Genesis 28:10
segments: ¶And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran. {Haran: Gr. Charran}

entries.title: Genesis 28:11
segments: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put [them for] his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

entries.title: Genesis 28:12
segments: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

entries.title: Genesis 28:13
segments: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I [am] the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

entries.title: Genesis 28:14
segments: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed. {spread...: Heb. break forth}

entries.title: Genesis 28:15
segments: And, behold, I [am] with thee, and will keep thee in all [places] whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done [that] which I have spoken to thee of.
